title: LF-VideoQA: Evaluating Long-Video Understanding with Long-Form Theory-of-Mind Questions
abstract: arXiv:2611.00383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The hardest part of understanding a long video is not pinpointing any one moment but synthesizing many, e.g., answering a question that requires tracking what develops across hours of content and articulating how the pieces fit together. To date, most long-video QA datasets require only a short answer or a multiple-choice selection, oversimplifying the long-video understanding task to retrieval. We introduce LF-VideoQA, a dataset for long-form, open-ended question answering over long narrative videos built on theory-of-mind questions: a character's belief depends on everything they have seen or been told, so each question demands assembling and reasoning from evidence distributed across the video. The dataset contains more than 6,300 questions on 94 recent films; each requires reasoning over scenes spanning an average of 23 minutes and comes with a question-specific rubric for recall and precision scoring. translated_title: LF-VideoQA：基于长文本心智理论问题评估长视频理解能力
translated_abstract: 理解一个长视频最困难的部分不在于精确定位某个单一时刻，而在于综合多个时刻的信息，例如回答一个需要追踪数小时内容中的发展脉络、并阐明各部分如何相互关联的问题。迄今为止，大多数长视频问答数据集仅要求简短答案或多项选择题选择，将长视频理解任务过度简化为检索任务。我们提出了LF-VideoQA，这是一个基于心智理论问题的、面向长叙事视频的长文本开放式问答数据集：一个角色的信念取决于其看到或被告知的一切，因此每个问题都需要整合并推理分布在整段视频中的证据。该数据集包含94部近期电影中的6,300多个问题；每个问题都需要对平均跨越23分钟的场景进行推理，并附有针对该问题的专用评分标准，用于召回率和精确度打分。该数据集的构建完全……
tldr: LF-VideoQA是一个基于心智理论问题的长视频开放式问答数据集，包含94部电影中的6,300多个需要综合跨场景（平均23分钟）证据进行推理的问题，并配有专用评分标准，从而超越简单检索范式、更真实地评估模型的长视频理解能力。
